notes.title: Health Pack Bug Patch
notes.notes: Small patch to fix health pack functionality. Health packs can now be refilled at spawners.

notes.title: Albatross v1.0.0-454 Patch Notes:
notes.notes:
Qureo Online Services
Login Failure Screen fixed

Map Updates
New Map! City is a New Elimination Map!

Item Updates
New Item! The Health Pack (only available in Elimination currently) will allow you to heal anywhere ONCE and this at the cost of one item slot until your next death!

notes.title: Status Update!
notes.notes: I decided to switch my focus to the Lyra template from Epic Games for now. I will be pursuing this template to keep the FPS Multiplayer Template pristine. I may go back to the FPS template and make it my own! I hope you see what can come in the future!
